text:
maria: FYI rolled kernel-selector v2 to canaries ~30m ago. Quick eval smoke shows quality dip on Mixtral long-context evals (span-recall down). Suspect RoPE-centering tweak + batching heuristic change.

javed: Can you paste the failing sample and metrics?

maria: example fail: expected `...Dr. Chen presented at the conference.` got `...Dr. Chen presented`. Long entity truncation on 2/50 prompts.

maria: eval deltas: rougeL -0.06, span-recall -3.8%, exact-match -1.1%. Token-level loss up ~0.004 on long tails.

sam: profiler from canary run (tail of 2048 tokens):
```
PROFILE: kernel_select:attn_tiled_v2 chosen 92% / attn_dense_fallback 8%
avg_latency/token: 3.8ms (prev: 3.2ms)
KV cache hits: 87.3% (prev: 95.6%)
prefix-merge churn spikes at batch boundaries -> KV index offsets misaligned
```

lee: KV hit drop + prefix churn suggests batching heuristic now reorders requests in a way that shifts KV indexing. We saw similar with tiled switch before. Could be RoPE-centering interacting with tiled kernel's rotary pos enc expectations.

javed: Does attn_tiled_v2 expect centered RoPE? We only enabled a small centering fix to reduce rotatory blowup for Mixtral / long sequences. Might be off-by-one in offset calc.

eva: On quant path we also toggled `prefer_int8_fastpath` for this kernel. That can change layout/word boundaries slightly and break some KV alignment assumptions.

maria: CI rollout log: `ci-bot: canary 12 hosts -> kernel-selector:v2 -> health ok` then `canary perf regressions flagged by eval-runner`.

ci-bot: [deploy] canary rollout started at 1972003200, 12 hosts; metric-alerts: long-context-eval-drop (sev3).

sam: I ran a quick bisect on canary images: turning off `ropecentering=true` restores span-recall to baseline. Turning off `prefer_int8_fastpath` also helps but not fully.

lee: So two orthogonal changes: ropecentering tweak + int8 fastpath. My suspicion: ropecentering shifted the absolute positions used for KV keys, tiled kernel assumes contiguous pos indexing -> misaligned caching and stale KV reads. The int8 path makes kernel choices deterministic in a different code-path so combined they amplify.

javed: Repro script (run locally on mixtral-8k):
```
# reproduce
python -m infra.run_infer --model mixtral-8k --kernel attn_tiled_v2 --ropecentering true --quant int8
# compare with ropecentering false
```
```
# quick assert
python tests/long_context_eval.py --samples 200 --assert-span-recall -0.5
```

eva: Suggested immediate mitigation: pin kernel-selector to prefer `attn_dense_fallback` for mixtral long-context routes or force `ropecentering=false` until we fix offset calc. Which is faster?

maria: For rollback path: we can toggle per-route policy in 5m (console change). Pinning to dense will increase cost ~12% but buys time.

sam: I can prepare a hotfix PR to attn_tiled_v2 offset calc and add unit test around KV index alignment. Will target in next 2 hours.

lee: Also add a fuzz test generating interleaved batches to catch prefix-merge churn.

javed: Plan: 1) pin route to dense fallback (maria) 2) sam PR for offset fix + test 3) eva validate quant fastpath interactions 4) roll canary with patched kernel and run eval harness 5) revert pin if stable.

maria: Doing step 1 now. Changing routing policy for `model:mixtral-8k route:long-context` -> `kernel_preference: dense, fallback: tiled` :eyes:

ci-bot: routing change applied on 12 hosts at 1972003520.

eva: I'll run quant-only tests against patched code once sam's PR lands.

sam: PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4821 - includes fix + unit + integration repro.

javed: Nice. Once PR merges let's roll a small canary (3 hosts) with the fix and run the long-context eval set. If metrics look good, schedule full rollout.

maria: Thanks team. I'll monitor eval-runner and post updates here. If anyone spots other failing prompts drop them in this thread. :thumbsup:
